name: migrate-tool
description: Migrates SIMATIC AX catalog 2510 projects to catalog 2610.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/contributed-migrate.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/contributed-migrate.js && node scripts/write-dist-package.cjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
